content: Ukraine war spilling into NATO territory. The war between Russia and Ukraine once again creeps onto European territory – from attacks on ships to missiles in Poland and fresh allegations of Russian operations inside Denmark.

author: Rob Schmitz
content: Luxury development planned on land some Albanians say is theirs, not Jared Kushner's. But Albanians in the area tell NPR this is not Kushner's land -- it's theirs.

author: Jane Arraf
content: Lebanese villagers return to wrecked homes as the Israeli army pulls back. In a pilot project in a village in southern Lebanon, Israeli forces have left and the Lebanese army moved it. But villagers who return find their houses wrecked.

author: Alina Selyukh
content: He expected a small-business loan. He got a 7-year nightmare. America's fastest-growing source of funding for small businesses is also one of the least regulated. One man has waged a long, lonely fight to recoup its punishing cost.

author: Cooper Katz McKim
content: Just how vulnerable are we to cyberattacks?. In a week of outages, we're thinking about the rising threat of AI-powered cyberattacks. But sometimes, it's not the most sophisticated attack that's concerning, but the easy targets buried in old software.

author: Shannon Bond
content: Critics are worried about Anthropic's influence after first day of public trading. Anthropic's initial public offering was a success for shareholders, including its founders. But there were also protests about whether the company can be a responsible steward of AI technology.

content: Google employees protest AI in schools policy. More than 550 Google employees signed a petition to allow schools access to Search without AI. Parents and educators protested outside Google offices in 6 cities last week for the same ask.

content: Machine Gods: Anthropic's early days. author: Alex Hager

author: Jenna McLaughlin
content: AI models are propelling rapid growth and revealing vulnerabilities. AI models are exposing the internet's longstanding insecurity, driving rapid change and technical outages.
